name: TCPA and ADA federal lawsuits filed, by district and fiscal year
description: Civil cases filed in each of the 94 federal district courts in each federal fiscal year under nature-of-suit code 485 (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) and code 446 (Americans with Disabilities Act, other: cases outside employment under the ADA sections on public entities and public accommodations, not only website cases), with the cases inside a multidistrict litigation counted apart and every civil case the district received that year. Counted from the Federal Judicial Center's civil case file, with each code's definition quoted from the U.S. Courts. Counts only: no party, lawyer or case number.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). TCPA and ADA federal lawsuits filed, by district and fiscal year (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24187571

distribution.name: tcpa-ada-filings.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: tcpa-ada-filings.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: tcpa-ada-filings-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in tcpa-ada-filings-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to tcpa-ada-filings.csv on id.

recordSet.name: tcpa-ada-filings
recordSet.description: The records of TCPA and ADA federal lawsuits filed, by district and fiscal year, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: district
field.description: The federal district court's key (for example CAC, NYS)

field.name: districtName
field.description: The district court's name

field.name: circuit
field.description: The federal circuit the district belongs to

field.name: natureOfSuit
field.description: The civil cover sheet's nature-of-suit code: 485 (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) or 446 (Americans with Disabilities Act, other)

field.name: natureOfSuitName
field.description: The code's name

field.name: code
field.description: tcpa or ada-other

field.name: fiscalYear
field.description: The federal fiscal year the cases were filed in (fiscal year N runs October 1 of N-1 to September 30 of N, by filing date)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Cases filed in the district and fiscal year under the code, multidistrict litigation cases included

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: filed
field.description: Of them, the cases outside a multidistrict litigation

field.name: filedInMdl
field.description: Of them, the cases that carry a multidistrict litigation docket number

field.name: total
field.description: Cases filed in the district and fiscal year under the code (filed plus filedInMdl)

field.name: allCivilFiled
field.description: Every civil case filed in the district that fiscal year

field.name: pctOfAllCivil
field.description: The code's cases as a percent of every civil case filed in the district that fiscal year

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the fiscal year

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the fiscal year

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
